items.statement: Each missed eligible mobilisation day in the first five eligible days is associated with higher odds of ICU-acquired weakness at discharge (adjusted odds ratio of at least 1.3 per day).
items.rationale: Partial adherence has not been studied; the data exist.

items.statement: The day-3 mobility scale adds little to a severity score for identifying later weakness.

items.rationale: Staff describe fewer physiotherapists at weekends.

summary: Three hypotheses; h1 is the study's question.
